Home of the Marist Poll | Polls, Analysis, Learning, and More

The Marist Institute for Public Opinion (MIPO) is a survey research center. MIPO is home to the Marist Poll and conducts polls on politics, the economy, sports, technology and more at the local, state, and national level.

Actual Article Body:
October 6, 2026

In the U.S. Senate contest in Maine, four points separate Democrat Troy Jackson and Republican incumbent Susan Collins among registered voters statewide. Maine Democrats have a wider nine-point advantage in the generic congressional ballot question, and Democrat Hannah Pingree leads Republican Bobby Charles by 12 points in the state’s gubernatorial contest. An anti-Trump sentiment and economic unease color the political landscape in Maine.

For additional data pertaining to the Midterm Elections in Maine, click on the link to the full table packet in the Survey Data button below.

This Marist Poll Maine survey of 1,505 Maine registered voters was conducted October 1st through October 4th, 2026 by the Marist Poll. Registered voters 18 years of age and older residing in Maine were contacted through a multi-mode design: By phone using live interviewers, by text, or online. Results for registered voters (n=1,505) are statistically significant within ±3.8 percentage points.
